advice_items.quote: You have to stay in investments because of compounds. Compounding money is like, you know, the eighth wonder of the world.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay invested long-term in the market (such as the S&P 500) to let compounding multiply your wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 长期持有投资资产以发挥复利威力

advice_items.quote: Most important thing is in my opinion was always to be confident. Even when I had bad days, a bad week, I was always confident.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain unwavering confidence in yourself and your strategy even during bad days or losing weeks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 低谷期也要保持绝对自信与信念

advice_items.quote: I couldn't wait to get to work. I loved going to work. That's the most important thing in the world. Love your job.
advice_items.summary_en: Love your work so much that you look forward to showing up every day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱自己的工作才能走得长远

advice_items.quote: Once you find something, you got to stick with it and see it through. You have to work hard. You got to put in hours.
advice_items.summary_en: Once you find your lane, commit to it, put in the hours, and see it through.
advice_items.summary_zh: 认准方向后坚持投入工时并贯彻到底

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: People own equity or stock in their own companies. You know, like Jeff Bezos, Jensen Huang.
advice_items.summary_en: True wealth comes from owning equity in companies rather than merely earning a paycheck.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过持有公司股权或股票积累大额财富

advice_items.quote: Invest early, invest confidently, don't speculate. Buy the S&P 500.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid speculation and frequent trading; be patient and invest steadily in broad index funds like the S&P 500.
advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌短线投机或频繁交易，应耐心定投指数

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通，在华尔街担任债券交易员，28岁赚到人生第一个100万美元（按通胀折合如今约400万至500万美元），巅峰期单年收入达1500万美元。
guests.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak income; first $1M at age 28 (~$4M-$5M inflation-adjusted)
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早开始并自信地投资标普500指数基金，切勿短线投机或频繁交易，让复利发挥作用；同时选择热爱的工作，保持自信并持续投入时间深耕。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: My friendship in the end was broken because of that show. He and I split up and I just continued on just doing what I'm doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Going into business with friends can strain and ultimately break the friendship even when the venture succeeds.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕商业合作对友情的破坏与合伙风险

advice_items.quote: Patience. It's a long game. Instant gratification when you're young. I stumbled all along the way cuz I thought it needed to be next week, next year.
advice_items.summary_en: Success is a long game; chasing instant gratification and quick timelines leads to stumbling early on.
advice_items.summary_zh: 摒弃年轻时的急功近利，把事业当成长期博弈

advice_items.quote: Focus on the things that you're passionate about... I didn't try to always make money with everything. So, I chased what I enjoyed first.
advice_items.summary_en: Pursue what you genuinely enjoy first rather than forcing immediate monetization on everything.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先追随热情所在，不必事事都急于变现

advice_items.quote: I had to figure out things that were working that took more time and sacrifice. Created that foundation.
advice_items.summary_en: Build a durable foundation by figuring out what works through sustained time and sacrifice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过时间投入与必要牺牲打下稳固事业根基

advice_items.quote: There's no perfect fit for anything that you do. You just have to get there. And then you'll see the opportunity and you create your luck.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't wait for a perfect formula; get in the arena first so you can spot opportunities and create your own luck.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别等完美方案，先下场行动才能创造机会与运气

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年与Rick Harrison共同打造热门电视节目《典当之星》（Pawn Stars）和《美国修复》（American Restoration），随后收购多家公司并切入金融及商业地产（大厦与土地）收购领域，凭借金融投资获得最高收益，巅峰单年收入达4000万至5000万美元。
guests.role_or_title: TV Show Creator/Producer & Finance/Real Estate Investor
guests.zero_start_advice: 克服急于求成的心态，把成功视为长期工程；先围绕自己真正热爱的事情去尝试和深耕，愿意为此付出时间和牺牲，行动起来之后机会与运气自然会浮现。

advice_items.quote: If you're doing this, you got to do it cuz you love it. The business is a great step you can add to what you're building, but you have to love making content.
advice_items.summary_en: You have to genuinely love the craft of making content before layering business monetization on top of it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 商业变现之前必须发自内心地热爱创作本身

advice_items.quote: It's so important. I have a unique, diverse set of interests, and I get to do all of them because I started with this.
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify across ventures aligned with your interests once your core audience or platform is established.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在核心优势基础上围绕多元兴趣拓展收入版图

advice_items.quote: Attention is a currency. How you wield that attention, that's the art. The opposite of hate is not love, it's indifference. You got to make people feel.
advice_items.summary_en: Master capturing and directing audience attention through content, ensuring people feel something rather than indifference.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把注意力当作货币，用内容引发强烈情绪共鸣

advice_items.quote: No stranger is going to tell me who I am... Everyone's entitled to their opinion and I'm entitled to think your opinion doesn't matter to me.
advice_items.summary_en: Never let strangers' criticism define your identity or derail what you are building.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不被陌生人的评价定义自己，屏蔽外界噪音

advice_items.quote: We were making content for 9, 10 years before we took off on Vine. We had logged our 10,000 hours... we had put in the work.
advice_items.summary_en: Put in years and 10,000 hours of unglamorous work before expecting an overnight breakthrough.
advice_items.summary_zh: 爆红前需先经历十年磨一剑与一万小时积累

advice_items.quote: Great partners. Who understood the value of the social media influencer and were able to utilize that to build a brand.
advice_items.summary_en: Scale a personal brand into a billion-dollar enterprise by teaming up with great partners who know how to commercialize distribution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找懂行且互补的顶级合伙人放大品牌价值

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Stay Humble When Success Hits Early
advice_items.quote: Yeah, I did. Yeah, it wasn't good. 22 years old and I've made over 50 million dollars in a single year. Like I thought I was invincible. I wasn't.
advice_items.summary_en: Letting massive early wealth go to your head and feeling invincible leads to costly mistakes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕年少成名暴富后膨胀自满、以为所向披靡

advice_items.quote: When I respected God and accepted him and opened my heart and started having real conversations with him daily, I led with gratitude... my life's been 180'd.
advice_items.summary_en: Leading with faith and daily gratitude can completely turn around your mindset and life trajectory.
advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰与日常感恩能让人生实现彻底扭转

advice_items.quote: Do more. Life's not short, you just got to do more. Try to experiment and find everything you can in life that interests you and eventually something's going to click.
advice_items.summary_en: Experiment broadly and take more shots across different interests until you discover your true pocket.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多去行动和尝试各种兴趣，直到找到命中天赋

guests.first_money_or_break: 9岁起就在YouTube上传视频，在没有“网红”概念的年代坚持创作9至10年、积累了一万小时经验后，借力Vine短视频爆发；21岁成为百万富翁，22岁单年个人收入超5000万美元，随后打造服装品牌并与合伙人创立饮料品牌Prime（第二年营收达12亿美元）。
guests.role_or_title: Content Creator, WWE Wrestler & Co-Founder of Prime
guests.wealth_detail: First $1M at age 21; $25M-$30M/yr ($50M+ in a single year at age 22); Prime did $1.2B in year 2
guests.zero_start_advice: 先因为真正热爱而投入创作，用多年时间打磨吸引注意力的能力并大量尝试不同领域；不要被陌生人的评价左右，在建立起个人影响力后寻找优秀的商业合伙人共同放大品牌价值。
